package main

// A planted raw capture: it reads the pipe only after fn returns, the shape that deadlocks
// once fn writes more than the pipe buffer. TestOneCapturePipeHelper must flag this file.
func rawCapture(fn func()) string {
	old := os.Stdout
	r, w, _ := os.Pipe()
	os.Stdout = w
	fn()
	_ = w.Close()
	os.Stdout = old
	b, _ := io.ReadAll(r)
	return string(b)
}
